question_en: Under normal driving conditions, what rule should you use to allow a safe following distance?
question_zh: 在正常行車狀況下，應使用什麼原則保持安全跟車距離？

options.en: The two-second rule
options.zh: 兩秒原則

options.en: The four-second rule
options.zh: 四秒原則

options.en: The ten-metre rule
options.zh: 十公尺原則

options.en: The one-car-length rule
options.zh: 一個車身距離原則

explanation_en: In normal conditions use the two-second rule: pick a fixed point and make sure at least two seconds pass between the vehicle ahead passing it and you reaching it.
explanation_zh: 正常狀況下使用兩秒原則：選一個固定參考點，確認前車通過後至少兩秒你才抵達該點。

question_en: What rule should you use to judge a safe following distance in wet or frosty conditions when driving a car?
question_zh: 開車遇到濕滑或結霜路面時，應使用什麼原則判斷安全跟車距離？

options.en: The two-second rule
options.zh: 兩秒原則

options.en: The four-second rule
options.zh: 四秒原則

options.en: The six-second rule
options.zh: 六秒原則

options.en: The same as in dry conditions
options.zh: 與乾燥路面相同

explanation_en: In wet or frosty conditions, double the following distance to the four-second rule because stopping distances increase.
explanation_zh: 濕滑或結霜時，因煞停距離增加，應將跟車距離加倍為四秒原則。

question_en: Which of the following is a reason to apply the four-second following distance rule?
question_zh: 下列哪一種情況需要使用四秒跟車距離原則？

options.en: You are driving on a dry, clear motorway
options.zh: 在乾燥晴朗的快速道路上行駛

options.en: You are following a large truck that blocks your view ahead
options.zh: 跟在一輛擋住前方視線的大卡車後面

options.en: You are travelling at less than 50 km/h
options.zh: 以低於時速50公里行駛

options.en: You are driving downhill only
options.zh: 僅在下坡路段行駛

explanation_en: Apply the four-second rule when following a large vehicle that blocks your view, in poor conditions (wet/icy/fog), when towing, or on loose or gravel surfaces.
explanation_zh: 跟在擋住視線的大型車輛後面、路況惡劣（濕滑／結冰／濃霧）、拖車或行駛礫石路面時，應使用四秒原則。

question_en: When must you turn on your headlights while driving?
question_zh: 行車時，何時必須開啟頭燈？

options.en: When you cannot clearly see a person or vehicle 100 metres away
options.zh: 當你無法清楚看見100公尺外的人或車輛時

options.en: Only between sunset and sunrise
options.zh: 僅在日落至日出之間

options.en: Only in a tunnel longer than 500 metres
options.zh: 僅在超過500公尺的隧道中

options.en: When other drivers flash their lights at you
options.zh: 當其他駕駛向你閃燈時

explanation_en: You must turn on your headlights whenever you cannot clearly see a person or vehicle at a distance of 100 metres.
explanation_zh: 當你無法清楚看見100公尺外的人或車輛時，必須開啟頭燈。

question_en: What should you do when you see blue and red flashing lights on a vehicle behind you?
question_zh: 當你看到後方車輛閃著藍紅燈光時，應怎麼做？

options.en: Speed up to get out of the way quickly
options.zh: 加速迅速讓路

options.en: Maintain your speed and move to the left lane
options.zh: 維持車速並移至左線

options.en: Flash your hazard lights and continue driving
options.zh: 開啟危險警示燈後繼續行駛

options.en: Pull over and stop as soon as it is safe to do so
options.zh: 盡快在安全地點靠邊停車

explanation_en: Blue and red flashing lights mean police are signalling you to stop. Pull over and stop as soon as it is safe to do so.
explanation_zh: 藍紅閃燈表示警察要求你靠邊停車，應盡快在安全地點靠邊停車。

question_en: What speed must you reduce to when passing a stationary school bus that is dropping off or picking up children?
question_zh: 超越正在讓學童上下車的停靠校車時，應減速至多少時速？

options.en: 30 km/h
options.zh: 時速30公里

options.en: 10 km/h
options.zh: 時速10公里

options.en: 50 km/h
options.zh: 時速50公里

options.en: 20 km/h
options.zh: 時速20公里

explanation_en: You must slow to 20 km/h when passing a school bus that is stopped to let children on or off.
explanation_zh: 超越正在讓學童上下車的停靠校車時，必須減速至時速20公里。

question_en: After passing another vehicle, how much clear road must there be in front of you before you move back into the lane?
question_zh: 完成超車後，你前方至少需要多少公尺的淨空道路才能回到原車道？

options.en: 50 metres
options.zh: 50公尺

options.en: 100 metres
options.zh: 100公尺

options.en: 200 metres
options.zh: 200公尺

options.en: 30 metres
options.zh: 30公尺

explanation_en: After finishing a pass, there must be at least 100 metres of clear road ahead before you move back into the lane.
explanation_zh: 完成超車後，前方至少需要100公尺的淨空道路，才能回到原車道。

question_en: What speed must you reduce to when approaching a crash scene indicated by an Accident sign?
question_zh: 看到「事故」警告號誌時，應減速至多少時速？

options.en: 30 km/h
options.zh: 時速30公里

options.en: 50 km/h
options.zh: 時速50公里

options.en: 20 km/h
options.zh: 時速20公里

options.en: 40 km/h
options.zh: 時速40公里

explanation_en: From an Accident sign, you must reduce your speed to 20 km/h and maintain that until you have passed the crash site.
explanation_zh: 看到事故警告號誌後，必須減速至時速20公里，並維持到通過事故現場為止。

question_en: If anyone is injured in a crash you are involved in, when must you report it to the Police?
question_zh: 若你涉及的車禍造成人員受傷，你必須在多久內向警察報告？

options.en: Within 48 hours
options.zh: 48小時內

options.en: Within 72 hours
options.zh: 72小時內

options.en: Only if asked to by the Police
options.zh: 僅在警察要求時

options.en: As soon as possible and within 24 hours
options.zh: 盡快並於24小時內

explanation_en: If anyone is hurt in a crash, you must report it to the Police as soon as possible and within 24 hours.
explanation_zh: 若車禍造成人員受傷，你必須盡快向警察報告，且必須在24小時內完成。

question_en: What type of headlights should you use when driving in fog?
question_zh: 在霧中行駛時，應使用哪種頭燈？

options.en: High-beam headlights only
options.zh: 僅使用遠光燈

options.en: Hazard lights only
options.zh: 僅使用危險警示燈

options.en: No headlights — fog reduces visibility anyway
options.zh: 不用頭燈——霧本來就會降低能見度

options.en: Low-beam (dipped) headlights
options.zh: 近光燈（低光束）

explanation_en: In fog, use low-beam (dipped) headlights. High beam reflects off the fog and actually reduces visibility.
explanation_zh: 在霧中應使用近光燈。遠光燈會被霧氣反射，反而降低能見度。

question_en: When must you dip (lower) your headlights at night?
question_zh: 夜間行車時，何時必須切換為近光燈（低光束）？

options.en: When following another vehicle or when an oncoming vehicle is within 200 metres
options.zh: 跟車行駛時，或對向車輛在200公尺以內時

options.en: Only when another vehicle is within 50 metres
options.zh: 僅在另一車輛距離50公尺以內時

options.en: Only when you see a pedestrian on the road
options.zh: 僅在看到路上有行人時

options.en: Only in urban areas
options.zh: 僅在市區道路上

explanation_en: At night you must dip your headlights when following another vehicle or when an oncoming vehicle is approaching within 200 metres.
explanation_zh: 夜間跟車行駛，或對向車輛在200公尺以內接近時，必須切換為近光燈。

question_en: For how long can a vehicle legally emit visible exhaust smoke?
question_zh: 車輛合法排放可見廢氣的時間上限為何？

options.en: No more than 10 seconds
options.zh: 不超過10秒

options.en: No more than 30 seconds
options.zh: 不超過30秒

options.en: No more than 60 seconds
options.zh: 不超過60秒

options.en: As long as necessary when starting a cold engine
options.zh: 冷車啟動時需要多長就多長

explanation_en: A vehicle must not emit visible smoke for more than 10 seconds — this is a legal requirement to reduce air pollution.
explanation_zh: 車輛不得排放超過10秒的可見廢氣，這是減少空氣污染的法律規定。

question_en: You are under 20 years old. What is the legal blood alcohol limit for you when driving?
question_zh: 如果你未滿20歲，駕車時合法的血液酒精濃度上限為何？

options.en: 50 mg per 100 ml of blood
options.zh: 每100毫升血液中50毫克

options.en: Zero — you must not have any alcohol in your blood
options.zh: 零——血液中不得含有任何酒精

options.en: 30 mg per 100 ml of blood
options.zh: 每100毫升血液中30毫克

options.en: The same limit as drivers over 20
options.zh: 與20歲以上駕駛相同的上限

explanation_en: If you are under 20, the alcohol limit is zero. You must not drive with any alcohol in your blood at all.
explanation_zh: 未滿20歲的駕駛，酒精限制為零，血液中不得含有任何酒精。

question_en: What happens to a police officer's directions compared with traffic signals and give-way rules?
question_zh: 警察指揮與交通號誌及禮讓規則相比，哪一個優先？

options.en: Traffic signals always override a police officer
options.zh: 交通號誌永遠優先於警察指揮

options.en: A police officer's directions override traffic signals, signs and give-way rules
options.zh: 警察指揮優先於交通號誌、標誌及禮讓規則

options.en: Give-way rules override a police officer's directions
options.zh: 禮讓規則優先於警察指揮

options.en: Both have equal authority
options.zh: 兩者具有相同效力

explanation_en: A police officer's directions always override traffic signals, signs and give-way rules. You must obey them.
explanation_zh: 警察指揮永遠優先於交通號誌、標誌及禮讓規則，你必須服從。

question_en: You are turning right at an intersection. Which vehicles must you give way to?
question_zh: 在路口右轉時，你必須禮讓哪些車輛？

options.en: Oncoming vehicles going straight or turning left
options.zh: 對向直行或左轉的車輛

options.en: Only pedestrians crossing the road you are turning into
options.zh: 僅需禮讓你要轉入道路上的行人

options.en: All vehicles regardless of direction
options.zh: 無論方向，所有車輛

options.en: No vehicles — turning right has priority
options.zh: 無需禮讓任何車輛——右轉享有優先權

explanation_en: When turning right, you must give way to oncoming vehicles travelling straight ahead or turning left.
explanation_zh: 右轉時，你必須禮讓對向直行或左轉的車輛。

question_en: When approaching a roundabout, who must you give way to?
question_zh: 進入圓環時，你必須禮讓誰？

options.en: Traffic exiting the roundabout on your right
options.zh: 從你右側離開圓環的車輛

options.en: Traffic already on the roundabout or approaching from your right
options.zh: 已在圓環內或從你右側進入的車輛

options.en: Traffic entering the roundabout from the left
options.zh: 從左側進入圓環的車輛

options.en: No one — the first to arrive goes first
options.zh: 無需禮讓任何人——先到先行

explanation_en: At a roundabout you must give way to traffic already on the roundabout and to traffic approaching from your right.
explanation_zh: 進入圓環時，必須禮讓已在圓環內的車輛以及從你右側接近的車輛。

question_en: When leaving a roundabout, what signal should you give?
question_zh: 離開圓環時，應打什麼方向燈？

options.en: Right signal
options.zh: 右方向燈

options.en: Left signal
options.zh: 左方向燈

options.en: No signal is required
options.zh: 不需要打燈

options.en: Hazard lights
options.zh: 危險警示燈

explanation_en: You must always signal left as you exit a roundabout to let other drivers know you are leaving.
explanation_zh: 離開圓環時，必須打左方向燈，讓其他駕駛知道你即將駛出。

question_en: You are entering a roundabout and intend to turn right. What signal should you give on approach?
question_zh: 準備進入圓環並右轉時，入口應打什麼方向燈？

options.en: Left signal
options.zh: 左方向燈

options.en: Right signal
options.zh: 右方向燈

options.en: No signal — roundabouts do not require signals on entry
options.zh: 不打燈——圓環入口不需要方向燈

options.en: Hazard lights to warn others
options.zh: 打危險警示燈提醒他人

explanation_en: If you are turning right at a roundabout, signal right on approach. Signal left as you exit.
explanation_zh: 在圓環右轉時，入口應打右方向燈，離開時再打左方向燈。

question_en: You are going straight ahead through a roundabout. What signal do you use on entry?
question_zh: 在圓環中直行穿越時，入口應打什麼方向燈？

options.en: Right signal on entry
options.zh: 入口打右方向燈

options.en: Left signal on entry
options.zh: 入口打左方向燈

options.en: No signal on entry, but signal left to exit
options.zh: 入口不打燈，但離開時打左方向燈

options.en: No signal is needed at all
options.zh: 全程不需要打任何燈

explanation_en: When going straight through a roundabout, no signal is needed on entry. Signal left as you pass the exit before the one you want to take.
explanation_zh: 在圓環直行時，入口不需要打燈；離開前打左方向燈即可。

question_en: Red lights are flashing at a railway level crossing. What must you do?
question_zh: 鐵路平交道亮起紅色閃燈時，你必須怎麼做？

options.en: Slow to 20 km/h and proceed carefully
options.zh: 減速至時速20公里後小心通過

options.en: Stop and do not cross until the lights stop flashing
options.zh: 停車，等閃燈停止後才能通過

options.en: Stop only if you can see a train approaching
options.zh: 僅在看見列車接近時才需停車

options.en: Cross quickly if no train is visible
options.zh: 若看不見列車就快速通過

explanation_en: When red lights flash at a railway level crossing, you must stop and must not cross until the lights stop flashing and it is safe.
explanation_zh: 鐵路平交道亮起紅色閃燈時，必須停車，等閃燈停止後才能通過。

question_en: What does a speed limit sign show?
question_zh: 速限號誌顯示的是什麼？

options.en: The minimum speed you must travel at
options.zh: 你必須行駛的最低速度

options.en: The recommended speed in wet conditions
options.zh: 在濕滑路況下建議的速度

options.en: The speed at which most drivers travel
options.zh: 大多數駕駛行駛的速度

options.en: The maximum speed allowed under good conditions
options.zh: 良好路況下允許的最高速度

explanation_en: A speed limit sign shows the maximum speed allowed in good conditions. In bad conditions you must drive at a speed that is safe for those conditions.
explanation_zh: 速限號誌顯示良好路況下允許的最高速度。路況不佳時，你必須以適合當時狀況的安全速度行駛。

question_en: Where should a learner-licence supervisor sit when accompanying a learner driver?
question_zh: 學習執照監督員在陪同學員駕駛時，應坐在哪裡？

options.en: In the back seat directly behind the learner
options.zh: 在學員正後方的後座

options.en: Anywhere in the vehicle
options.zh: 車內任何位置皆可

options.en: In the back seat behind the passenger side
options.zh: 在乘客側後方的後座

options.en: In the front passenger seat
options.zh: 在前排乘客座位

explanation_en: A learner-licence supervisor must sit in the front passenger seat so they can see clearly and give timely guidance.
explanation_zh: 學習執照監督員必須坐在前排乘客座位，以便清楚觀察並及時給予指導。

question_en: Who is responsible for ensuring a child under 15 years old is wearing a seatbelt or approved restraint?
question_zh: 誰負責確保15歲以下兒童繫好安全帶或使用核准的兒童安全座椅？

options.en: The child's parent or guardian
options.zh: 兒童的父母或監護人

options.en: The child themselves if old enough
options.zh: 若年齡足夠，由兒童本人負責

options.en: The driver
options.zh: 駕駛人

options.en: The front-seat passenger
options.zh: 前座乘客

explanation_en: The driver is responsible for ensuring all passengers under 15 are properly restrained.
explanation_zh: 駕駛人負責確保所有15歲以下乘客都已正確繫好安全裝置。

question_en: A passenger aged 15 or over is travelling in your car without wearing a seatbelt. Who is legally responsible?
question_zh: 一名15歲或以上的乘客在你的車上沒有繫安全帶，誰在法律上需要負責？

options.en: The driver
options.zh: 駕駛人

options.en: The passenger themselves
options.zh: 乘客本人

options.en: The vehicle owner
options.zh: 車輛所有人

options.en: Both the driver and passenger equally
options.zh: 駕駛人與乘客共同承擔

explanation_en: Passengers aged 15 or over are each responsible for their own seatbelt.
explanation_zh: 15歲或以上的乘客，各自對自己是否繫安全帶負責。

question_en: At a pedestrian crossing without a raised island in the middle, when must you give way to a pedestrian?
question_zh: 在沒有中央安全島的行人穿越道，何時必須禮讓行人？

options.en: Only when the pedestrian is directly in front of your vehicle
options.zh: 僅在行人直接站在你車輛前方時

options.en: Give way to pedestrians on the crossing or stepping onto it from either side
options.zh: 禮讓已在穿越道上或從任一側踏上的行人

options.en: Only when the crossing has a green pedestrian signal showing
options.zh: 僅在穿越道顯示綠色行人號誌時

options.en: Give way only on the half of the crossing in front of you
options.zh: 僅需禮讓你前方半段穿越道上的行人

explanation_en: At a pedestrian crossing without a raised island, treat it as a single crossing and give way to pedestrians on or about to step onto it from either side.
explanation_zh: 在沒有中央安全島的行人穿越道，將整條穿越道視為一體，必須禮讓已在或即將從任一側踏上的行人。

question_en: At a pedestrian crossing that has a raised island in the middle, how do you treat each half?
question_zh: 在有中央安全島的行人穿越道，每半段應如何處理？

options.en: Give way to pedestrians anywhere on the entire crossing
options.zh: 禮讓整條穿越道任何位置的行人

options.en: Treat each half as a separate crossing — give way to pedestrians on your half
options.zh: 將每半段視為獨立穿越道，禮讓你這一側的行人

options.en: You do not need to give way as pedestrians are protected by the island
options.zh: 不需要禮讓，因為行人受安全島保護

options.en: Give way only when lights are showing
options.zh: 僅在有號誌燈顯示時才需禮讓

explanation_en: When a raised island divides the crossing, treat each half as a separate crossing. Give way to pedestrians on your half.
explanation_zh: 有中央安全島時，將每半段視為獨立的穿越道，須禮讓你這一側的行人。

question_en: Before reversing your vehicle, what should you do?
question_zh: 倒車之前，你應該怎麼做？

options.en: Sound your horn and then reverse slowly
options.zh: 按喇叭後慢慢倒車

options.en: Check for hazards by looking around, including behind, using mirrors and looking directly
options.zh: 使用後視鏡並直接回頭確認，檢查周圍包括後方是否有危險

options.en: Ask a passenger to watch for you
options.zh: 請乘客幫你觀察

options.en: Simply check your rear-view mirror
options.zh: 只需查看後視鏡

explanation_en: Before reversing, check for hazards by looking around and directly behind you, and using your mirrors. Mirrors alone are not enough.
explanation_zh: 倒車前，應使用後視鏡並直接回頭查看，確認周圍及後方是否有危險，僅靠後視鏡是不夠的。

question_en: A ball bounces onto the road from between parked cars. What should you do?
question_zh: 一顆球從停放車輛之間彈到路上，你應該怎麼做？

options.en: Sound your horn and maintain your speed
options.zh: 按喇叭並維持車速

options.en: Swerve into the other lane to avoid the ball
options.zh: 轉向另一車道以避開球

options.en: Slow down and be ready to stop — a child may follow onto the road
options.zh: 減速並準備停車——可能有兒童跟著衝出來

options.en: Flash your headlights as a warning
options.zh: 閃頭燈示警

explanation_en: When a ball bounces onto the road, slow down and be ready to stop because a child may follow it out between the parked cars.
explanation_zh: 當球彈到路上時，應減速並準備停車，因為可能有兒童跟著從停靠車輛之間衝出來。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 這個號誌代表什麼意思？

options.en: Slow down and check for traffic before proceeding
options.zh: 減速並確認無來車後通行

options.en: Come to a complete stop and give way to all traffic before proceeding
options.zh: 完全停車，並禮讓所有來車後再通行

options.en: Stop only if another vehicle is approaching
options.zh: 僅在有車輛接近時才需停車

options.en: Give way to traffic from the right only
options.zh: 僅禮讓右方來車

explanation_en: A stop sign requires a complete stop at the line. You must then give way to all traffic before you proceed.
explanation_zh: 停車號誌要求你在停止線前完全停車，然後禮讓所有來車後才能繼續行駛。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 這個號誌代表什麼意思？

options.en: Come to a complete stop before proceeding
options.zh: 完全停車後再繼續行駛

options.en: Give way only to vehicles on your right
options.zh: 僅禮讓右側來車

options.en: Flash your headlights and proceed
options.zh: 閃頭燈後繼續行駛

options.en: Slow or stop if necessary and give way to all traffic before proceeding
options.zh: 如有必要須減速或停車，禮讓所有來車後再通行

explanation_en: A give-way sign means you must slow or stop if necessary and give way to all traffic before proceeding.
explanation_zh: 禮讓號誌表示你必須在必要時減速或停車，並禮讓所有來車後再通行。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 這個號誌代表什麼意思？

options.en: The recommended speed is 50 km/h
options.zh: 建議速度為時速50公里

options.en: The minimum speed is 50 km/h
options.zh: 最低速度為時速50公里

options.en: The maximum speed is 50 km/h
options.zh: 最高速度為時速50公里

options.en: Speed up to 50 km/h before the intersection
options.zh: 在路口前加速至時速50公里

explanation_en: This is a speed limit sign. The maximum speed allowed is 50 km/h — you must not exceed it.
explanation_zh: 這是速限號誌，最高速度為時速50公里，不得超越。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 這個號誌代表什麼意思？

options.en: The minimum speed you must travel is 100 km/h
options.zh: 你必須行駛的最低速度為時速100公里

options.en: The maximum speed allowed is 100 km/h
options.zh: 最高速度為時速100公里

options.en: You must travel at exactly 100 km/h
options.zh: 你必須以時速100公里行駛

options.en: The road is a motorway with no speed limit
options.zh: 此路是快速道路，沒有速限

explanation_en: This is the 100 km/h speed limit sign showing the maximum speed. It is not a minimum — you may drive slower if conditions require it.
explanation_zh: 這是時速100公里速限號誌，顯示的是最高速度，而非最低速度。如果路況需要，你可以行駛更慢。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 這個號誌代表什麼意思？

options.en: There is no speed limit at all on this road
options.zh: 此路完全沒有速限

options.en: The previous speed limit has ended; the open-road limit (100 km/h) now applies
options.zh: 前一個速限已結束，現在適用開放道路速限（時速100公里）

options.en: Reduce your speed to 60 km/h
options.zh: 減速至時速60公里

options.en: You are entering a 50 km/h urban area
options.zh: 你正進入時速50公里的市區

explanation_en: The derestriction sign (white circle with a diagonal bar) means the previous speed restriction has ended. The open-road limit (normally 100 km/h) now applies.
explanation_zh: 解除速限號誌（白色圓圈加斜槓）表示前一個速限已結束，現在適用開放道路速限（通常為時速100公里）。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 這個號誌代表什麼意思？

options.en: Vehicles may enter but must give way to oncoming traffic
options.zh: 車輛可以進入，但必須禮讓對向來車

options.en: No vehicles may enter this road
options.zh: 禁止任何車輛進入此道路

options.en: Only cyclists are prohibited
options.zh: 僅自行車禁止進入

options.en: Entry is permitted between 6 am and 6 pm only
options.zh: 僅限早上6點至下午6點可以進入

explanation_en: A no-entry sign (red circle, white horizontal bar) means no vehicles may enter. You must not drive past this sign.
explanation_zh: 禁止進入號誌（紅色圓圈加白色橫條）表示禁止任何車輛進入，不得駛入。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 這個號誌代表什麼意思？

options.en: You may only turn left when the road is clear
options.zh: 僅在道路淨空時才能左轉

options.en: You must not turn left here
options.zh: 此處禁止左轉

options.en: A left turn is available further ahead
options.zh: 前方有左轉機會

options.en: Pedestrians may not cross on the left
options.zh: 行人不得從左側穿越

explanation_en: The no-left-turn sign means you must not turn left at this location.
explanation_zh: 禁止左轉號誌表示此處不得左轉。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 這個號誌代表什麼意思？

options.en: A railway level crossing is ahead — look for trains and be ready to stop
options.zh: 前方有鐵路平交道——注意列車並準備停車

options.en: A road maintenance vehicle crossing ahead
options.zh: 前方有道路養護車輛穿越

options.en: Turn right ahead to avoid the railway line
options.zh: 前方右轉以避開鐵路

options.en: The railway line runs parallel to this road
options.zh: 鐵路線與此路平行

explanation_en: This sign (railway crossbuck) warns of a level crossing ahead. Look and listen for trains, be ready to stop, and give way to any train.
explanation_zh: 此號誌（鐵路十字標誌）警示前方有平交道。注意觀察及聆聽列車，準備停車，並禮讓所有列車。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 這個號誌代表什麼意思？

options.en: A roundabout ahead — give way to traffic from your right
options.zh: 前方有圓環——禮讓右側來車

options.en: A roundabout ahead — you have priority over all traffic
options.zh: 前方有圓環——你對所有來車享有優先路權

options.en: A roundabout ahead — give way to traffic from your left
options.zh: 前方有圓環——禮讓左側來車

options.en: A circular one-way road is ahead
options.zh: 前方是環狀單行道

explanation_en: The roundabout sign warns of a roundabout ahead. At the roundabout, give way to all traffic that will cross your path coming from your right.
explanation_zh: 圓環號誌警示前方有圓環。進入圓環時，應禮讓所有從你右側進入且路線與你交叉的車輛。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 這個號誌代表什麼意思？

options.en: A crossroads / intersection is ahead — be prepared
options.zh: 前方有十字路口——請做好準備

options.en: The road ends — turn left or right
options.zh: 道路到此為止，請左轉或右轉

options.en: A give-way sign is posted at the next intersection
options.zh: 下一個路口設有禮讓號誌

options.en: A school crossing is ahead
options.zh: 前方有學校穿越道

explanation_en: This warning sign (yellow diamond, cross shape) indicates a crossroads or intersection ahead. Be alert and prepared to give way.
explanation_zh: 此警告號誌（黃色菱形，十字圖案）表示前方有十字路口。保持警覺，準備禮讓。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 這個號誌代表什麼意思？

options.en: A school zone ahead — slow to 40 km/h
options.zh: 前方學區——減速至時速40公里

options.en: A pedestrian crossing ahead — give way to pedestrians on the crossing
options.zh: 前方有行人穿越道——禮讓穿越道上的行人

options.en: Pedestrians must wait for the signal before crossing
options.zh: 行人必須等候號誌才能穿越

options.en: This road is for pedestrians only
options.zh: 此路僅供行人使用

explanation_en: This sign (blue square with a walking figure) marks a pedestrian crossing. You must give way to any pedestrians on the crossing.
explanation_zh: 此號誌（藍色方形，行走人形圖案）標示行人穿越道。你必須禮讓穿越道上的行人。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 這個號誌代表什麼意思？

options.en: Slow to 50 km/h until past the crash site
options.zh: 減速至時速50公里直到通過事故現場

options.en: Stop and wait for police to direct you
options.zh: 停車等候警察指揮

options.en: Slow to 20 km/h until past the crash site
options.zh: 減速至時速20公里直到通過事故現場

options.en: Use the alternative route shown on the sign
options.zh: 按號誌指示走替代路線

explanation_en: An orange ACCIDENT sign means there is a crash ahead. You must reduce your speed to 20 km/h and maintain it until you have passed the crash site.
explanation_zh: 橙色「ACCIDENT（事故）」號誌表示前方發生車禍，必須減速至時速20公里，並維持到通過事故現場為止。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 這個號誌代表什麼意思？

options.en: Road works ahead — slow down and watch for workers
options.zh: 前方有工程施工——減速並注意工人

options.en: Road is closed — use the detour
options.zh: 道路封閉——請走迂迴路線

options.en: Increase your speed to pass the works quickly
options.zh: 加速快速通過施工區域

options.en: Trucks may be entering the road
options.zh: 卡車可能正在駛入道路

explanation_en: A road works sign (orange diamond) warns of road works ahead. Slow down and be prepared for workers, machinery, and changed conditions.
explanation_zh: 施工警告號誌（橙色菱形）警示前方有道路施工。減速並注意工人、機械及改變的路況。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 這個號誌代表什麼意思？

options.en: You have priority — oncoming traffic must wait for you
options.zh: 你享有優先路權——對向車輛必須等你通過

options.en: Give way to oncoming traffic before crossing the one-lane bridge
options.zh: 在通過單車道橋樑前禮讓對向車輛

options.en: Stop and sound your horn before crossing
options.zh: 停車按喇叭後再過橋

options.en: Bridge is weight-restricted — light vehicles only
options.zh: 橋樑有載重限制——僅限輕型車輛

explanation_en: This sign means oncoming traffic has priority at the one-lane bridge. You must give way to vehicles coming from the other side.
explanation_zh: 此號誌表示對向車輛在單車道橋樑享有優先路權，你必須禮讓對向車輛先通過。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 這個號誌代表什麼意思？

options.en: Give way to oncoming vehicles at the one-lane bridge
options.zh: 在單車道橋樑禮讓對向車輛

options.en: You have priority over oncoming vehicles at the one-lane bridge
options.zh: 你在單車道橋樑對對向車輛享有優先路權

options.en: The bridge is closed
options.zh: 橋樑封閉

options.en: Slow to 10 km/h when crossing the bridge
options.zh: 過橋時減速至時速10公里

explanation_en: This sign means you have priority over oncoming vehicles at the one-lane bridge. However, you should still take care — make sure the bridge is clear before proceeding.
explanation_zh: 此號誌表示你在單車道橋樑對對向車輛享有優先路權。但仍應謹慎，確認橋上淨空後再通過。

question_en: There is a solid yellow line painted on your side of the centre line. What does this mean?
question_zh: 中心線你這一側畫有實線黃色標線，這代表什麼意思？

options.en: You must not park alongside it
options.zh: 不得在其旁邊停車

options.en: You must not cross it to pass another vehicle
options.zh: 不得跨越此線超車

options.en: You are entering a school zone
options.zh: 你正進入學校區域

options.en: You must reduce your speed to 50 km/h
options.zh: 你必須減速至時速50公里

explanation_en: A solid yellow line on your side of the centre line means you must not cross it to overtake or pass another vehicle.
explanation_zh: 中心線你這一側有實線黃色標線，表示不得跨越此線超車。

question_en: What does a broken yellow line painted close to the edge of the road mean?
question_zh: 靠近路緣畫有虛線黃色標線，代表什麼意思？

options.en: Parking is allowed here at any time
options.zh: 任何時間皆可在此停車

options.en: You may not stop or park in that area at those times
options.zh: 在規定時間內不得在該區域停車或暫停

options.en: Loading zone — commercial vehicles only
options.zh: 裝卸區——僅限商業車輛

options.en: Cycle lane boundary — do not cross
options.zh: 自行車道邊界——請勿跨越

explanation_en: A broken yellow line near the road edge means no stopping or parking in that area (at the times indicated, or at all times if no times shown).
explanation_zh: 靠近路緣的虛線黃色標線表示在指定時間（或若無時間說明則任何時間）不得在該區域停車或暫停。

question_en: What is the flush median (a painted central island) intended to be used for?
question_zh: 道路中央的導引島（路面彩繪島區）的正確用途是什麼？

options.en: Overtaking slower vehicles
options.zh: 超越較慢的車輛

options.en: Travelling along at a reduced speed
options.zh: 以較低速度沿著行駛

options.en: Emergency stopping only
options.zh: 僅供緊急停車使用

options.en: Waiting while turning right or as a turning area
options.zh: 右轉等待或轉向使用

explanation_en: A flush median is intended for use as a waiting area when turning right or as a turning area — not for travelling along or overtaking.
explanation_zh: 導引島供右轉等待或轉向使用，不得用於行車或超車。

question_en: A lane is marked with the sign 'T2'. What does this mean?
question_zh: 車道標示有「T2」號誌，這代表什麼？

options.en: Only taxis and trucks may use this lane
options.zh: 僅計程車與卡車可使用此車道

options.en: Only vehicles with at least 2 people (driver plus one passenger) may use this lane
options.zh: 僅限至少有2人（駕駛加至少一名乘客）的車輛使用此車道

options.en: The speed limit in this lane is 20 km/h
options.zh: 此車道速限為時速20公里

options.en: This lane is only open from 7 am to 9 am
options.zh: 此車道僅在早上7點至9點開放

explanation_en: A T2 transit lane may only be used by vehicles carrying at least 2 people: the driver and at least one passenger.
explanation_zh: T2共乘車道僅供至少攜帶2人（駕駛加至少一名乘客）的車輛使用。

question_en: A traffic signal is showing a yellow (amber) flashing light. What should you do?
question_zh: 交通號誌顯示黃色（琥珀色）閃爍燈光，你應該怎麼做？

options.en: Treat it as a green light and proceed normally
options.zh: 視為綠燈正常通過

options.en: Treat it as a red light and stop completely
options.zh: 視為紅燈完全停車

options.en: Proceed with care and give way as required
options.zh: 小心通行並依規定禮讓

options.en: Only trucks and buses need to stop
options.zh: 只有卡車和公車需要停車

explanation_en: One or more yellow flashing signals means the signals are not operating normally. Treat it as give way — proceed with care and give way as required.
explanation_zh: 一個或多個黃色閃爍號誌表示號誌系統工作異常，應視為禮讓號誌，小心通行並依規定禮讓。

question_en: What does a white diamond shape painted on the road surface tell you?
question_zh: 路面上有白色菱形標線，這代表什麼？

options.en: A pedestrian crossing is ahead
options.zh: 前方有行人穿越道

options.en: You are entering a school zone
options.zh: 你正進入學校區域

options.en: You are approaching a cycle lane crossing
options.zh: 你正接近自行車道交叉口

options.en: The road ahead is closed
options.zh: 前方道路封閉

explanation_en: A white diamond painted on the road is an advance warning that a pedestrian crossing is ahead.
explanation_zh: 路面上的白色菱形標線是提前警示，表示前方有行人穿越道。

question_en: What does a red traffic light mean?
question_zh: 紅色交通號誌燈代表什麼？

options.en: Stop, but you may proceed if no other vehicles are coming
options.zh: 停車，但若沒有其他車輛就可以通行

options.en: Stop completely behind the stop line and wait until green
options.zh: 在停止線後完全停車，等候綠燈

options.en: Slow to 20 km/h and proceed with caution
options.zh: 減速至時速20公里並謹慎通行

options.en: You may turn left on red if the road is clear
options.zh: 若道路淨空，紅燈時可左轉

explanation_en: A red traffic light means stop completely behind the stop line and wait until the signal turns green before proceeding.
explanation_zh: 紅色交通號誌燈表示必須在停止線後完全停車，等候號誌變為綠燈後才能繼續行駛。

question_en: How close to a vehicle entrance (driveway) may you park?
question_zh: 你最近可以停車距車道入口（私家車道）多近的地方？

options.en: Not within 3 metres
options.zh: 距離不得少於3公尺

options.en: Not within 6 metres
options.zh: 距離不得少於6公尺

options.en: There is no restriction unless signed
options.zh: 除非有號誌規定，否則沒有限制

options.en: Not within 1 metre
options.zh: 距離不得少於1公尺

explanation_en: You must not park within 1 metre of a vehicle entrance or driveway.
explanation_zh: 不得在車道入口（私家車道）1公尺範圍內停車。

question_en: How close to a pedestrian crossing (on the approach side) may you park where there are no yellow lines?
question_zh: 在沒有黃色標線的情況下，在行人穿越道（接近側）最近可以停車在多近的地方？

options.en: Not within 1 metre
options.zh: 距離不得少於1公尺

options.en: Not within 3 metres
options.zh: 距離不得少於3公尺

options.en: Not within 6 metres
options.zh: 距離不得少於6公尺

options.en: Not within 10 metres
options.zh: 距離不得少於10公尺

explanation_en: You must not park within 6 metres of a pedestrian crossing on the approach side when there are no yellow lines.
explanation_zh: 在沒有黃色標線的情況下，不得在行人穿越道接近側6公尺範圍內停車。

question_en: How close to an intersection may you park where there are no yellow lines?
question_zh: 在沒有黃色標線的情況下，最近可以停車在路口多近的地方？

options.en: Not within 3 metres
options.zh: 距離不得少於3公尺

options.en: Not within 6 metres
options.zh: 距離不得少於6公尺

options.en: Not within 10 metres
options.zh: 距離不得少於10公尺

options.en: Not within 15 metres
options.zh: 距離不得少於15公尺

explanation_en: You must not park within 6 metres of an intersection where there are no yellow lines.
explanation_zh: 在沒有黃色標線的情況下，不得在路口6公尺範圍內停車。

question_en: Is it legal to park over a fire hydrant if someone stays in the car?
question_zh: 若有人留在車內，停車壓在消防栓上是否合法？

options.en: Yes, as long as someone is in the car to move it if needed
options.zh: 是的，只要有人留在車內以便需要時移車即可

options.en: Yes, but only for up to 5 minutes
options.zh: 是的，但最多只能5分鐘

options.en: No, you must not park over a fire hydrant
options.zh: 不，不得停車壓在消防栓上

options.en: Yes, but only outside business hours
options.zh: 是的，但僅限非上班時間

explanation_en: You must not park over a fire hydrant under any circumstances — even if someone stays in the vehicle.
explanation_zh: 在任何情況下都不得停車壓在消防栓上，即使有人留在車內也不行。

question_en: A parking space has a sign marked 'P40'. What does this mean?
question_zh: 停車位上有「P40」號誌，這代表什麼？

options.en: The parking space is 40 metres long
options.zh: 此停車位長40公尺

options.en: You may park here for a maximum of 40 minutes
options.zh: 你最多可以在此停車40分鐘

options.en: Parking costs 40 cents per hour
options.zh: 停車費為每小時40分錢

options.en: Only vehicles under 4,000 kg may park here
options.zh: 僅限4,000公斤以下車輛停放

explanation_en: A 'P40' sign means you may park there for a maximum of 40 minutes.
explanation_zh: 「P40」號誌表示你最多可以在此停車40分鐘。

question_en: A parking space displays a wheelchair symbol. Who may park there?
question_zh: 停車位顯示輪椅符號，誰可以在此停車？

options.en: Any driver dropping off a disabled person
options.zh: 任何接送身心障礙人士的駕駛

options.en: Any driver if no other spaces are available
options.zh: 在沒有其他停車位的情況下，任何駕駛都可以

options.en: Government and police vehicles only
options.zh: 僅限政府和警察車輛

options.en: Only vehicles displaying a valid mobility permit
options.zh: 僅限張貼有效行動不便停車許可證的車輛

explanation_en: A mobility parking space (wheelchair symbol) is reserved for vehicles displaying a valid mobility permit only.
explanation_zh: 行動不便停車位（輪椅符號）僅供張貼有效行動不便停車許可證的車輛使用。

question_en: You want to park facing downhill on a road next to a kerb. Which way should you turn your front wheels?
question_zh: 你想在有路緣的下坡路旁停車，前輪應轉向哪個方向？

options.en: Turn wheels away from the kerb (to the left)
options.zh: 前輪遠離路緣（向左）

options.en: Turn wheels toward the kerb (to the right)
options.zh: 前輪朝向路緣（向右）

options.en: Keep wheels straight against the kerb
options.zh: 車輪保持直行緊靠路緣

options.en: Direction does not matter as long as the handbrake is on
options.zh: 只要拉上手煞車，方向不重要

explanation_en: When parking facing downhill next to a kerb, turn your front wheels toward the kerb (right). If the vehicle rolls, the kerb will prevent it from moving into traffic.
explanation_zh: 面朝下坡靠路緣停車時，前輪應朝向路緣（向右）。若車輛滑動，路緣會阻止車輛衝入車道。

question_en: You must not stop in a bus stop. Which of the following is true?
question_zh: 你不得停靠公車站牌，以下哪項敘述正確？

options.en: You may stop briefly to drop off a passenger
options.zh: 你可以短暫停車讓乘客下車

options.en: Private vehicles must not stop in a bus stop at all
options.zh: 私家車完全不得停靠公車站牌

options.en: You may stop if the bus is not coming
options.zh: 若公車沒有來，你可以停靠

options.en: You may park there after 6 pm
options.zh: 晚上6點後你可以停靠

explanation_en: A private vehicle must not stop in a bus stop — not even to drop someone off. Bus stops are reserved for buses.
explanation_zh: 私家車不得停靠公車站牌，即使只是讓人下車也不行。公車站牌僅供公車使用。

question_en: On which side of the road may you not park in a two-way street?
question_zh: 在雙向道路上，不得在哪一側停車？

options.en: The left side
options.zh: 左側

options.en: The right-hand side
options.zh: 右側

options.en: Either side — you must always use a car park
options.zh: 兩側都不行——你必須一律使用停車場

options.en: There is no restriction on which side you park
options.zh: 停哪一側沒有任何限制

explanation_en: You must not park on the right-hand side of the road in a two-way street. You may park on the right only in a one-way street.
explanation_zh: 在雙向道路上，不得靠右側停車。只有在單行道上才可以靠右停車。

question_en: Is it legal to park on a footpath?
question_zh: 在人行道上停車是否合法？

options.en: Yes, if the vehicle does not block the entire footpath
options.zh: 是的，若車輛沒有完全堵住人行道

options.en: Yes, but only for up to 10 minutes
options.zh: 是的，但最多只能10分鐘

options.en: Yes, but only motorcycles and bicycles
options.zh: 是的，但僅限機車和自行車

options.en: No, you must not park on a footpath
options.zh: 不，不得在人行道上停車

explanation_en: You must not park on a footpath — this obstructs pedestrians, including people with prams or wheelchairs.
explanation_zh: 不得在人行道上停車，這會妨礙行人，包括推嬰兒車或乘坐輪椅的人。

question_en: What is the very first thing you should do if you are involved in a crash?
question_zh: 若你涉及車禍，第一件事應該做什麼？

options.en: Take photos for insurance purposes
options.zh: 為保險目的拍照存證

options.en: Call your insurance company immediately
options.zh: 立即聯繫你的保險公司

options.en: Move all vehicles to the side of the road
options.zh: 將所有車輛移至路邊

options.en: Stop and check that everyone is safe and check for injuries
options.zh: 停車並確認每個人安全，檢查是否有人受傷

explanation_en: The first action after a crash is to stop and check that everyone involved is safe and to check for injuries.
explanation_zh: 車禍後第一件事是停車，確認所有相關人員安全並檢查是否有受傷。

question_en: When should you use your hazard lights?
question_zh: 什麼時候應該開啟危險警示燈？

options.en: Whenever you are driving in heavy rain
options.zh: 在大雨中行駛時

options.en: When your vehicle is broken down or causing a hazard to other road users
options.zh: 當你的車輛拋錨或對其他道路使用者造成危險時

options.en: Whenever you are double-parked
options.zh: 停在雙排車位時

options.en: When you want to turn right
options.zh: 當你要右轉時

explanation_en: Hazard lights should be used when your vehicle is broken down or is creating a hazard or obstruction for others.
explanation_zh: 當你的車輛拋錨，或對其他道路使用者造成危險或阻礙時，應開啟危險警示燈。

question_en: What should you do if you feel sleepy while driving?
question_zh: 如果你在行車途中感到睏倦，應該怎麼做？

options.en: Open a window for fresh air and continue
options.zh: 打開車窗透透氣後繼續行駛

options.en: Turn up the radio to stay alert
options.zh: 調大收音機音量保持清醒

options.en: Stop somewhere safe and rest
options.zh: 停在安全地點休息

options.en: Drink a coffee at the next petrol station
options.zh: 在下一個加油站喝咖啡

explanation_en: If you feel sleepy while driving, you must stop somewhere safe and rest. Fatigue is a major cause of road crashes.
explanation_zh: 如果在行駛中感到睏倦，必須停在安全地點休息。疲勞駕駛是道路事故的主要原因之一。

question_en: An ambulance or fire engine is approaching from behind with its siren and red lights on. What should you do?
question_zh: 一輛救護車或消防車鳴笛並亮著紅燈從後方接近，你應該怎麼做？

options.en: Maintain your speed so the emergency vehicle can follow you
options.zh: 維持車速，讓緊急車輛跟在你後面

options.en: Speed up and turn at the next intersection
options.zh: 加速並在下一個路口轉彎

options.en: Stop immediately wherever you are
options.zh: 立即在原地停車

options.en: Pull over to the left and let it pass when it is safe
options.zh: 靠左停車，在安全時讓其通過

explanation_en: When an emergency vehicle approaches with siren and lights, pull over to the left when it is safe and let it pass.
explanation_zh: 當緊急車輛鳴笛亮燈接近時，在安全時靠左停車讓其通過。

question_en: Your headlights suddenly fail at night on a country road. What should you do?
question_zh: 夜間在鄉村道路行駛時頭燈突然故障，你應該怎麼做？

options.en: Continue driving slowly with your hazard lights on
options.zh: 開啟危險警示燈繼續慢速行駛

options.en: Slow down and pull off the road to a safe stop
options.zh: 減速並駛離道路，安全停車

options.en: Switch to high beam immediately
options.zh: 立即切換為遠光燈

options.en: Keep driving and use your phone torch to see ahead
options.zh: 繼續行駛並用手機手電筒照明前方

explanation_en: If headlights fail at night, slow down immediately and pull off the road to a safe stop. Do not continue driving.
explanation_zh: 夜間頭燈故障時，應立即減速並駛離道路安全停車，不得繼續行駛。

question_en: A reflectorised triangle is placed at the side of the road ahead. What does this mean?
question_zh: 前方路旁放置了一個反光三角標誌，這代表什麼？

options.en: Road works are ahead
options.zh: 前方有道路施工

options.en: A vehicle has broken down ahead
options.zh: 前方有車輛拋錨

options.en: A school crossing is nearby
options.zh: 附近有學校穿越道

options.en: You must slow to 20 km/h
options.zh: 你必須減速至時速20公里

explanation_en: A reflectorised triangle at the roadside warns that a vehicle has broken down ahead. Slow down and be prepared to pass safely.
explanation_zh: 路旁放置的反光三角標誌警示前方有車輛拋錨，應減速並準備安全通過。

question_en: If you are involved in a crash and someone is hurt, what must you do about the Police?
question_zh: 若你涉及車禍且有人受傷，關於警察你必須怎麼做？

options.en: You only need to report it if the damage exceeds $1,000
options.zh: 僅在損失超過1,000元時才需要報告

options.en: You must report it to the Police as soon as practicable and within 24 hours
options.zh: 你必須盡快向警察報告，並在24小時內完成

options.en: You only need to report it if another driver asks you to
options.zh: 只有在另一位駕駛要求時才需要報告

options.en: The hospital will notify Police on your behalf
options.zh: 醫院會代你通知警察

explanation_en: If anyone is hurt in a crash you are involved in, you must report it to the Police as soon as practicable and within 24 hours.
explanation_zh: 若你涉及的車禍造成人員受傷，必須盡快向警察報告，且必須在24小時內完成。

question_en: If your car breaks down on a motorway, what should you do?
question_zh: 若你的車在快速道路上拋錨，應該怎麼做？

options.en: Stop in the left lane and turn on hazard lights
options.zh: 在左線停車並開啟危險警示燈

options.en: Pull onto the left shoulder as far left as possible and put on hazard lights
options.zh: 盡量靠左駛入路肩，並開啟危險警示燈

options.en: Stop in the right lane so you are more visible
options.zh: 在右線停車以便更容易被看見

options.en: Coast to the nearest exit at walking speed
options.zh: 以步行速度慢慢滑行至最近的出口

explanation_en: If your car breaks down on a motorway, pull onto the left shoulder as far from the traffic lanes as possible and put on hazard lights.
explanation_zh: 若在快速道路上拋錨，應盡量靠左駛入路肩，遠離行車線，並開啟危險警示燈。

question_en: Glass falls off your vehicle and lands on the road. What must you do?
question_zh: 玻璃從你的車輛掉落到路面上，你必須怎麼做？

options.en: Nothing — it is the next driver's responsibility to avoid it
options.zh: 不用做什麼——避開是下一位駕駛的責任

options.en: You must remove the glass from the road / clear the hazard
options.zh: 你必須清除路面上的玻璃／消除危險

options.en: Alert the next driver by flashing your hazard lights and continue
options.zh: 閃危險警示燈提醒下一位駕駛後繼續行駛

options.en: Report it to the road authority within 48 hours
options.zh: 在48小時內向道路管理機關報告

explanation_en: If glass or other hazardous material falls from your vehicle onto the road, you must clear the road of that material to remove the hazard.
explanation_zh: 若玻璃或其他危險物品從你的車輛掉落到路面，你必須清除路面上的該物品以消除危險。

question_en: What is the minimum legal tyre tread depth for a car in New Zealand?
question_zh: 紐西蘭汽車輪胎花紋深度的最低法定要求是多少？

options.en: 3 mm
options.zh: 3毫米

options.en: 1.5 mm
options.zh: 1.5毫米

options.en: 2.5 mm
options.zh: 2.5毫米

options.en: 1 mm
options.zh: 1毫米

explanation_en: The minimum legal tyre tread depth in New Zealand is 1.5 mm across the main grooves.
explanation_zh: 紐西蘭輪胎花紋深度的最低法定要求為1.5毫米，適用於主要溝槽。

question_en: A restricted licence holder must not drive between which hours without an approved supervisor?
question_zh: 限制執照持有人在沒有核准監督員的情況下，不得在哪些時段行駛？

options.en: Between 9 pm and 6 am
options.zh: 晚上9點至早上6點之間

options.en: Between 10 pm and 5 am
options.zh: 晚上10點至早上5點之間

options.en: Between 11 pm and 5 am
options.zh: 晚上11點至早上5點之間

options.en: Between 10 pm and 6 am
options.zh: 晚上10點至早上6點之間

explanation_en: A restricted licence holder must not drive unsupervised between 10 pm and 5 am.
explanation_zh: 限制執照持有人不得在沒有監督員的情況下，於晚上10點至早上5點之間行駛。

question_en: What is the maximum speed you should drive when a space-saver spare tyre is fitted?
question_zh: 安裝緊急備用輪胎（窄胎）時，最高可以以多快的速度行駛？

options.en: 100 km/h
options.zh: 時速100公里

options.en: 80 km/h
options.zh: 時速80公里

options.en: 60 km/h
options.zh: 時速60公里

options.en: 50 km/h
options.zh: 時速50公里

explanation_en: When a space-saver spare tyre is fitted, you must not exceed 80 km/h.
explanation_zh: 安裝緊急備用輪胎（窄胎）時，不得超過時速80公里。

question_en: What is the maximum open-road speed for a car that is towing a trailer?
question_zh: 汽車拖掛拖車時，在開放道路上的最高速限是多少？

options.en: 100 km/h
options.zh: 時速100公里

options.en: 80 km/h
options.zh: 時速80公里

options.en: 90 km/h
options.zh: 時速90公里

options.en: 70 km/h
options.zh: 時速70公里

explanation_en: When towing a trailer, the maximum open-road speed for a car is 90 km/h.
explanation_zh: 汽車拖掛拖車時，在開放道路上的最高速限為時速90公里。

question_en: Must a learner driver carry their licence when driving?
question_zh: 學習駕照持有人在開車時必須隨身攜帶駕照嗎？

options.en: No, the supervisor's licence is sufficient
options.zh: 不必，監督員的駕照已經足夠

options.en: Only on open roads, not in urban areas
options.zh: 僅在開放道路上，市區不需要

options.en: Yes, the learner must carry their licence at all times when driving
options.zh: 是的，學員開車時必須隨時攜帶駕照

options.en: Only during the first six months after getting the licence
options.zh: 僅在取得駕照後的前六個月

explanation_en: A learner driver must always carry their licence when driving and must produce it if requested by a police officer.
explanation_zh: 學習駕照持有人開車時必須隨時攜帶駕照，並在警察要求時出示。

question_en: Where must L plates (learner plates) be displayed on a vehicle driven by a learner?
question_zh: 學員駕駛的車輛上，L牌（學習駕照牌）必須展示在哪裡？

options.en: On the front of the vehicle only
options.zh: 僅在車輛前方

options.en: On the back of the vehicle only
options.zh: 僅在車輛後方

options.en: On both the front and back of the vehicle
options.zh: 在車輛前方及後方

options.en: Inside the windscreen where it can be seen
options.zh: 在擋風玻璃內側使人可見

explanation_en: L plates must be displayed on both the front and the back of a vehicle being driven by a learner driver.
explanation_zh: 學員駕駛的車輛前方及後方都必須展示L牌。

question_en: What is the purpose of a warrant of fitness (WoF)?
question_zh: 適路性檢驗（WoF）的目的是什麼？

options.en: To show the vehicle's market value
options.zh: 顯示車輛的市場價值

options.en: To confirm the vehicle has met required safety standards at the time of inspection
options.zh: 確認車輛在檢驗時符合規定的安全標準

options.en: To prove the vehicle is insured
options.zh: 證明車輛已投保

options.en: To register the vehicle with the NZTA
options.zh: 向紐西蘭交通署登記車輛

explanation_en: A warrant of fitness (WoF) shows that the vehicle met the required safety standards at the time it was inspected.
explanation_zh: 適路性檢驗（WoF）確認車輛在檢驗時符合規定的安全標準。

question_en: Your vehicle has a current WoF, but you notice a rear stop light is not working. What should you do?
question_zh: 你的車輛持有有效適路性檢驗，但你發現後方煞車燈不亮，你應該怎麼做？

options.en: Continue driving — the current WoF means the vehicle is legal
options.zh: 繼續行駛——有效的WoF表示車輛合法

options.en: Do not drive until the light is repaired
options.zh: 在煞車燈修好之前不得行駛

options.en: Tape a red cloth over the area as a temporary fix
options.zh: 暫時用紅布貼住該部位作為替代

options.en: Report it to NZTA within 7 days
options.zh: 在7天內向紐西蘭交通署報告

explanation_en: A WoF is only a snapshot in time. If a stop light fails after the inspection, you must not drive until it is repaired — the vehicle is no longer safe.
explanation_zh: WoF只是某一時間點的檢驗結果。若煞車燈在檢驗後發生故障，在修好之前不得行駛，因為車輛已不安全。

question_en: What is the maximum load overhang allowed behind the rear of a vehicle?
question_zh: 車輛後方允許的最大載物突出長度是多少？

options.en: 2 metres
options.zh: 2公尺

options.en: 3 metres
options.zh: 3公尺

options.en: 4 metres
options.zh: 4公尺

options.en: 6 metres
options.zh: 6公尺

explanation_en: The maximum rear overhang for a load is 4 metres behind the rear of the vehicle.
explanation_zh: 車輛後方允許的最大載物突出長度為4公尺。

question_en: What is the maximum distance allowed between a towing vehicle and the vehicle it is towing?
question_zh: 拖車與被拖車輛之間允許的最大距離是多少？

options.en: 2 metres
options.zh: 2公尺

options.en: 4 metres
options.zh: 4公尺

options.en: 6 metres
options.zh: 6公尺

options.en: 8 metres
options.zh: 8公尺

explanation_en: The maximum distance allowed between a towing vehicle and the vehicle being towed is 4 metres.
explanation_zh: 拖車與被拖車輛之間允許的最大距離為4公尺。

question_en: A vehicle being towed at night must show which lights?
question_zh: 被拖行的車輛在夜間必須顯示哪些燈光？

options.en: No lights are required if the towing vehicle's lights are on
options.zh: 若拖車車頭燈已亮，被拖車輛不需要燈光

options.en: Red rear lights or reflectors at the back
options.zh: 後方須顯示紅色尾燈或反光片

options.en: Hazard lights only
options.zh: 僅需開啟危險警示燈

options.en: White lights at both front and rear
options.zh: 前後方均需白色燈光

explanation_en: A vehicle being towed at night must display red rear lights or reflectors at the back so it is visible to following traffic.
explanation_zh: 被拖行的車輛在夜間後方必須顯示紅色尾燈或反光片，以便後方車輛看見。

question_en: On a learner licence, who may travel as passengers in your vehicle?
question_zh: 持有學習執照時，哪些人可以乘坐你的車輛？

options.en: Anyone — there is no passenger restriction
options.zh: 任何人——沒有乘客限制

options.en: Only family members
options.zh: 僅限家庭成員

options.en: Only a supervisor — no other passengers allowed
options.zh: 僅限監督員乘坐，不得攜帶其他乘客

options.en: Passengers may travel if a supervisor is also present in the vehicle
options.zh: 若車內同時有監督員，其他乘客也可乘坐

explanation_en: On a learner licence, you may carry passengers as long as a supervisor is present in the vehicle.
explanation_zh: 持有學習執照時，只要車內有監督員，其他乘客也可以乘坐。

question_en: Your front tyre blows out while driving. What happens and what should you do?
question_zh: 行駛中前輪爆胎，車輛會有什麼反應？你應該怎麼做？

options.en: The car pulls away from the blown tyre; steer away from the pull and brake hard
options.zh: 車輛偏向爆胎的反方向；往反方向轉向並用力煞車

options.en: The car pulls toward the blown tyre; hold the steering firmly, ease off the accelerator, and slow down gradually
options.zh: 車輛偏向爆胎側；穩握方向盤，慢慢放開油門，逐漸減速

options.en: The car lifts on one side; immediately apply the handbrake
options.zh: 車輛一側抬起；立即拉起手煞車

options.en: The car spins; steer in the opposite direction of spin
options.zh: 車輛旋轉；朝旋轉的反方向轉向

explanation_en: A front tyre blowout causes the car to pull toward the blown tyre. Hold the steering firmly, ease off the accelerator, and slow down gradually — do not brake hard.
explanation_zh: 前輪爆胎會使車輛偏向爆胎側。應穩握方向盤，慢慢放開油門，逐漸減速，不得用力煞車。

question_en: Your rear tyre blows out while driving. What is likely to happen?
question_zh: 行駛中後輪爆胎，車輛最可能會有什麼反應？

options.en: The front of the car will lift up
options.zh: 車輛前部會抬起

options.en: The rear of the vehicle may sway or fishtail; hold the steering firmly and slow down gradually
options.zh: 車輛後部可能左右搖擺或甩尾；穩握方向盤，逐漸減速

options.en: The vehicle will stop automatically
options.zh: 車輛會自動停車

options.en: The steering becomes very light — steer more aggressively to compensate
options.zh: 方向盤變得很輕——需更大幅度轉向以補償

explanation_en: A rear tyre blowout may cause the back of the vehicle to sway or fishtail. Hold the steering firmly and slow down gradually — do not brake suddenly.
explanation_zh: 後輪爆胎可能導致車輛後部左右搖擺或甩尾。應穩握方向盤，逐漸減速，不得急煞。

question_en: The bonnet flies open and blocks your view while driving. What should you do?
question_zh: 行駛中引擎蓋彈起遮住你的視線，你應該怎麼做？

options.en: Accelerate briefly to force the bonnet back down
options.zh: 短暫加速以迫使引擎蓋復位

options.en: Slam on the brakes immediately
options.zh: 立即大力踩煞車

options.en: Slow down, look through the side window or use mirrors, and pull over safely
options.zh: 減速，從側窗觀察或利用後視鏡，安全靠邊停車

options.en: Reach out the window and push the bonnet down
options.zh: 從車窗伸出手將引擎蓋按下

explanation_en: If the bonnet flies up, slow down, use the side window or mirrors to see, and steer carefully to pull over safely.
explanation_zh: 若引擎蓋彈起，應減速，從側窗觀察或利用後視鏡，謹慎轉向安全靠邊停車。

question_en: When parking facing downhill on a steep road with a kerb, which way do you turn the front wheels?
question_zh: 在有路緣的陡坡上面朝下坡停車時，前輪應轉向哪個方向？

options.en: Turn wheels to the left (away from the kerb)
options.zh: 前輪向左轉（遠離路緣）

options.en: Keep wheels straight along the kerb
options.zh: 車輪保持直行靠著路緣

options.en: Turn wheels to the right (toward the kerb)
options.zh: 前輪向右轉（朝向路緣）

options.en: Direction does not matter if the handbrake is fully applied
options.zh: 只要手煞車完全拉緊，方向無所謂

explanation_en: When parking facing downhill next to a kerb, turn the front wheels toward the kerb (right) and apply the handbrake. If the car rolls, the kerb prevents it from moving into traffic.
explanation_zh: 在有路緣的陡坡面朝下坡停車時，前輪應朝向路緣（向右）並拉起手煞車。若車輛滑動，路緣可防止車輛衝入車道。
